newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's cuts Kirin unit's long-term debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts Kirin unit's long-term debt rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday that it had cut its long-term debt rating of Kirin Brewery Co Ltd's finance unit in the Netherlands to Aa3 to Aa1.

The debt affected are Kirin International Finance (Netherlands) BV's $500 million euro medium-term note programme and 10 billion yen senior unsecured euro notes due November 2000 issued under a keepwell agreement with Kirin, Moody's said in a statement.

"This rating action is based on Moody's expectation that it will be difficult for Kirin to preserve and recover its market share over the medium term in the increasingly volatile beer market in Japan," the credit rating firm said.

Moody's also said that it believes that Kirin's earnings in the beer sector are expected to decrease further due to growing expenses for sales activities while the contribution from its non-beer businesses will remain limited.
